Amendment 0001 -   

 This amendment changes the following: 

 1.     Solicitation submission due date extended from 23 Nov 2026 to 30 Nov 2026 at 1100AM (PST). 

 2.     Delivery due date for CLINS 0001 and 0002 are changed from 30 SEP 2027 to 14 Oct 2027. 

 3.    Revised the following Specifications: 

 a.    SECTION 26 00 00.10 26 SUBMITTAL PROCEDURES 
    Revised paragraph 3.10.2 Stator Burnout. 
    Revised paragraph 3.13.8.2 Required winding Impregnations.  

 See revised Performance Work Statement for details.  

  
 Original Post -   
This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial products or commercial services prepared in accordance with part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Offers are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. 

 Solicitation number W912EF27QA006 is issued as a request for quotation (RFQ) for motor rewind and asbestos abatement services. 

 This acquisition is   not   set-aside for small business concerns. This solicitation incorporates provisions and clauses by reference. The full text of provisions and clauses may be accessed electronically at www.acquisition.gov. 

  

 ***Please see attachments for full solicitation details, instructions, and specifications. Be sure all submissions include required documentation outlined in the Instructions To Offerors.***
